priorityList: When running Firestarter, delay your first Combustion until the target is below 90% health.
Cast Combustion when ready and then go into the Combustion Priority List.
Cast Meteor immediately as it becomes available; if delayed more than 10 seconds, save it for Combustion.
Cast Pyroblast when you have Hot Streak using Pyroblast Chaining after a Fireball cast so they both land at the same time.
Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Cast Fireball as your filler to generate Hot Streak or Heating Up.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Meteor between 2 to 8 seconds of Combustion left.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Pyroblast when you have Hot Streak.
Combustion Priority List: Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
